title: Unencrypted Data Transmission

title: Profile Creation via Linking
description: External entity EE1 (Parent User) initiates a data flow to Process P3 (Child Profile Management) to create a child profile. This flow involves the collection of quasi-identifiers (name, DOB, gender, govt ID) which, when combined with the parent's identity, allows for the creation of a unique user profile. This constitutes a linking interaction where the combination of attributes reveals additional information about the data subject.
assumptions: The system allows external users to create child profiles by providing personal identifiers.
